title: Makita gold detachable nutsetter B-40353 8mm
description: Makita is the leading manufacturer of professional power tools on the market. Impact gold extreme Torsion technology is a unique design which focuses the forces exerted on to a regular screw bit away from the tip, meaning less chance of breakage during the most vigorous impact applications. The B-40353 separates the 2 parts of the holder allowing for direct access to the magnet to allow for easy removal of the swarf build-up. The socket piece and shank are each manufactured to optimal hardness, with improved breaking strength. The B-40353 Nutsetter has up to 20 times the life compared to a standard Nutsetter.
